entities.name: Saint Eumenes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Saint Eumenes was a bishop of Gortyna in Crete during the 7th century. His feast day is 18 September. He gave up his wealth as a young man and was chosen as bishop of Gortyna. Many miracles are attributed to him: he killed a venomous snake, drove out demons, and healed the sick. He is said to have performed miracles at Gortyna, Rome, and in the Thebaid. He died in exile in the Thebaid.
